text: 英国经济创两年半最快增速，人工智能的推广带动企业支出，消费者支出也顶住了伊朗冲突引发的能源冲击。英国国家统计局周四公布，第三季度国内生产总值(GDP)环比增长0.7%，较第二季度的0.5%加快，符合预期。仅9月份GDP就增长0.2%，好于此前预期的零增长。自伊朗冲突爆发以来，英国经济表现强于此前有关经济放缓的预期，其中与采用人工智能相关的支出提供了支撑。经济学家已被迫上调今年的经济增长预测。英国财政大臣约翰·希利周三表示，他的目标是让2027年经济表现再次超过预期。按人均计算，第三季度产出增长0.7%，为2021年底以来最大增幅，当时英国经济正从新冠疫情
text_en: UK economy grows at fastest pace in two and a half years, with AI adoption driving business spending and consumer spending withstanding the energy shock caused by the Iran conflict. The Office for National Statistics said Thursday that GDP grew 0.7% quarter-on-quarter in Q3, accelerating from 0.5% in Q2 and in line with expectations. GDP alone rose 0.2% in September, better than the previous expectation of zero growth. Since the Iran conflict broke out, the UK economy has outperformed earlier expectations of a slowdown, supported by spending related to AI adoption. Economists have been forced to raise their growth forecasts for this year. UK Chancellor John Healey said Wednesday that his goal is for the economy to beat expectations again in 2027. On a per capita basis, output rose 0.7% in Q3, the largest increase since late 2021, when the UK economy was recovering from the COVID-19 pandemic
